title: Parallel neuronal ensembles control behavior across sensorimotor levels in Drosophila
source_locator: Fig. 1E-G; Fig. 2A-B, F-G, J-K, M; Fig. S2-1B; Fig. S2-2C-F; Supplemental Table 2 (DNp07_1); Video S1
quote: In summary, DNp07, DNp10, DNp47, and DNg79 drive extensions of all six legs as part of the landing response
mapping_basis: Paper uses the Namiki/MANC type name DNp07, which is a MANC type in type_list.csv; line SS02276 also maps to DNp07 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 625 nm LED, 150 uW/mm2, 50 ms pulses, 10 s inter-stimulus interval (Methods); 1 s pulses at 25-100% intensity for wingbeat in Fig. S2-2E-F
sensory_condition: pin-tethered (thorax), flying; only trials with continuous flight analysed; filmed side and bottom at 150 Hz, DeepLabCut tracking
coordination_notes: Landing response: strong front leg extension with simultaneous extension and anterior rotation of middle and hind legs; single movement per pulse (reference line for normalisation).
penetrance: 100% of flies showed landing responses (Fig. 1F); in flight also reduced wingbeat frequency and flight cessation in 6/19 flies (Fig. 2J-K); downward abdominal deflection (Fig. 2M)
n_flies_note: N = 13 flies, n = 52 trials for leg tracking (Supp. Table 2); N = 18-19 flies in wingbeat experiment (Fig. 2J-K)
notes: Named DNp07_1 in paper. Fig. 1D drawing states 653 nm, Methods state 625 nm. Wingbeat/flight-cessation results from the same pin-tethered setup folded into this record as secondary behaviours.

title: Parallel neuronal ensembles control behavior across sensorimotor levels in Drosophila

mapping_basis: Paper uses the type name DNp07 (line DNp07_2), a MANC type in type_list.csv; SS02612 maps to DNp07 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 625 nm LED, 150 uW/mm2, 50 ms pulses, 10 s inter-stimulus interval
sensory_condition: pin-tethered (thorax), flying; filmed side and bottom at 150 Hz, DeepLabCut tracking

notes: Named DNp07_2 in paper. Paper does not describe off-target expression; kit driver_lines.csv notes approx. 2 background off-target cell types for SS02612 (Namiki 2018), so specificity set to unknown.

title: Parallel neuronal ensembles control behavior across sensorimotor levels in Drosophila
source_locator: Fig. 1E-G; Fig. 2A-B, F-G, J-K, M; Fig. S2-1B, G; Supplemental Table 2 (DNp10); Video S3
quote: DNp10 and DNp47 consistently drove more laterally-directed middle and hind leg movements compared to all other DNs
mapping_basis: Paper uses the type name DNp10, a MANC type in type_list.csv; SS01608 maps to DNp10 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 625 nm LED, 150 uW/mm2, 50 ms pulses, 10 s inter-stimulus interval
sensory_condition: pin-tethered (thorax), flying; filmed side and bottom at 150 Hz, DeepLabCut tracking
coordination_notes: Landing leg extension of all six legs; less anterior rotation of middle and hind legs than DNp07, more laterally directed middle/hind leg movements.
penetrance: most flies landed (Fig. 1F bar slightly below 100%, value read from figure); no change in wingbeat frequency, no flight cessation (Fig. 2J-K); mild downward abdominal deflection (Fig. 2M)
n_flies_note: N = 8 flies, n = 32 trials (Supp. Table 2); N = 11 in wingbeat experiment
notes: Wingbeat measurement in same setup showed no effect (folded into this record).

title: Parallel neuronal ensembles control behavior across sensorimotor levels in Drosophila
source_locator: Fig. 1E-G; Fig. 2A-B, F-G, M; Fig. S2-1B; Supplemental Table 1, Supplemental Table 2 (DNp47); Video S4
quote: In summary, DNp07, DNp10, DNp47, and DNg79 drive extensions of all six legs as part of the landing response
mapping_basis: Paper uses the type name DNp47, a MANC type in type_list.csv (hemibrain PS293); the driver R70C09-GAL4 is not in the kit (proposed).
stimulation: 625 nm LED, 150 uW/mm2, 50 ms pulses, 10 s inter-stimulus interval
sensory_condition: pin-tethered (thorax), flying; filmed side and bottom at 150 Hz, DeepLabCut tracking
coordination_notes: Landing leg extension; less anteriorly directed, more lateral middle and hind leg movements than DNp07 (like DNp10).
penetrance: 100% of flies showed landing responses (Fig. 1F); no downward abdominal deflection (Fig. 2M)
notes: Driver is a Gen-1 GAL4 line: genotype GMR70C09-GAL4 attP2, BDSC #39524; Supplemental Table 1 lists its identifier as 'SS39524' (apparently the BDSC number, not a split-GAL4 name). Paper does not describe its expression pattern beyond 'restricted expression'.

title: Parallel neuronal ensembles control behavior across sensorimotor levels in Drosophila
source_locator: Fig. 1E-G; Fig. 2A-B, F-G, M; Fig. 4D; Fig. S2-1B, I; Supplemental Table 2 (DNg79); Video S5
quote: During DNg79 activation, the front leg coxae rotated forwards and underneath the head, followed by a dorsally directed, lateral extension of the distal segments
mapping_basis: Paper uses the type name DNg79, a MANC type in type_list.csv; kit lists SS81942 as labelling DNg79 and DNg31.
stimulation: 625 nm LED, 150 uW/mm2, 50 ms pulses, 10 s inter-stimulus interval
type_coverage: paper: DNg79 includes two left-right pairs (DNg79a/b in Fig. 4C); coverage by line not stated

other_cell_types: DNg31 (per kit driver_lines.csv, Zung/Namiki 2025 annotation 'DNg31, DNg79'; not mentioned by this paper)
coordination_notes: Greatest front and middle leg extension of all landing DNs; front leg coxae rotate forward under the head, front legs lifted above head; middle legs reach very anterior.
